source_text: Gabaonitae astu foedus ineunt panibus aridis utribus ruptis — mendacium metu mortis. Principes iurant; populus murmurat. Foedus tamen servandum — iurisiurandi religio. Fiunt lignarii aquarii — servi in domo Dei.
pass_a_gloss: Gibeonites by-craft covenant enter with-breads dry skins burst — lie from-fear of-death. Leaders swear; people murmurs. Covenant however to-be-kept — of-oath religion. They-become woodcutters water-carriers — servants in house of-God.
pass_b_english: The Gibeonites craftily make a covenant with dry bread and burst wineskins — a lie from fear of death. Leaders swear; the people murmur. Yet the oath must be kept. They become [[woodcutters and water-carriers for the house of God >> Bible:Joshua 9:21-27]].
